As a result Lambda functions in new member accounts are not scanned for vulnerable dependencies.
aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_auto_enable.pass_when: PASS when the verified delegated administrator's autoEnable.lambda is true.
aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_auto_enable.fail_when: FAIL when the verified delegated administrator's autoEnable.lambda is false.
aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_auto_enable.not_applicable_when: No delegated administrator is configured, or the enabled delegated administrator is a different account (DENIED if the reads were denied).

aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_code_auto_e.description: Scope-level check run only when the caller account is verified as the ENABLED Inspector delegated administrator: FAILs when the organization configuration's autoEnable.lambdaCode is false, so Lambda code scanning is not auto-enabled for member accounts. As a result Lambda function code in new member accounts is not scanned for injection flaws or hard-coded secrets.
aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_code_auto_e.pass_when: PASS when the verified delegated administrator's autoEnable.lambdaCode is true.
aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_code_auto_e.fail_when: FAIL when the verified delegated administrator's autoEnable.lambdaCode is false.
aws.b.inspector.admin_lambda_code_auto_e.not_applicable_when: No delegated administrator is configured, or the enabled delegated administrator is a different account (DENIED if the reads were denied).

aws.b.inspector.ec2_organization_auto_en.description: Scope-level regional check on the Inspector organization configuration: FAILs when the inventory is completely empty, or when autoEnable.ec2 is false. This is the literal upstream variant: without auto-enable of EC2 instance vulnerability scanning, new EC2 instances in member accounts are not scanned for OS/package CVEs and network reachability.
aws.b.inspector.ec2_organization_auto_en.pass_when: PASS when autoEnable.ec2 is true in the region's organization configuration.
aws.b.inspector.ec2_organization_auto_en.fail_when: FAIL when the configuration is empty without a recognized not-administrator/unsupported reply, or autoEnable.ec2 is false.
aws.b.inspector.ec2_organization_auto_en.not_applicable_when: Caller is not the Inspector delegated administrator, or the region does not support the operation.

aws.b.inspector.ecr_organization_auto_en.description: Scope-level regional check on the Inspector organization configuration: FAILs when the inventory is completely empty, or when autoEnable.ecr is false. This is the literal upstream variant: without auto-enable of ECR container image scanning, images pushed to member-account ECR repositories are not scanned for vulnerabilities.
aws.b.inspector.ecr_organization_auto_en.pass_when: PASS when autoEnable.ecr is true in the region's organization configuration.
aws.b.inspector.ecr_organization_auto_en.fail_when: FAIL when the configuration is empty without a recognized not-administrator/unsupported reply, or autoEnable.ecr is false.
aws.b.inspector.ecr_organization_auto_en.not_applicable_when: Caller is not the Inspector delegated administrator, or the region does not support the operation.

aws.b.inspector.lambda_code_organization.description: Scope-level regional check on the Inspector organization configuration: FAILs when the inventory is completely empty, or when autoEnable.lambdaCode is false. This is the literal upstream variant: without auto-enable of Lambda code scanning, Lambda function code in new member accounts is not scanned for injection flaws or hard-coded secrets.
aws.b.inspector.lambda_code_organization.pass_when: PASS when autoEnable.lambdaCode is true in the region's organization configuration.
aws.b.inspector.lambda_code_organization.fail_when: FAIL when the configuration is empty without a recognized not-administrator/unsupported reply, or autoEnable.lambdaCode is false.
aws.b.inspector.lambda_code_organization.not_applicable_when: Caller is not the Inspector delegated administrator, or the region does not support the operation.

aws.b.inspector.lambda_organization_auto.description: Scope-level regional check on the Inspector organization configuration: FAILs when the inventory is completely empty, or when autoEnable.lambda is false. This is the literal upstream variant: without auto-enable of Lambda standard (dependency) scanning, Lambda functions in new member accounts are not scanned for vulnerable dependencies.
aws.b.inspector.lambda_organization_auto.pass_when: PASS when autoEnable.lambda is true in the region's organization configuration.
aws.b.inspector.lambda_organization_auto.fail_when: FAIL when the configuration is empty without a recognized not-administrator/unsupported reply, or autoEnable.lambda is false.
aws.b.inspector.lambda_organization_auto.not_applicable_when: Caller is not the Inspector delegated administrator, or the region does not support the operation.

aws.b.lambda.active_tracing.description: For Lambda functions, FAILs when TracingConfig.Mode is PassThrough instead of Active. Without active X-Ray tracing, invocation paths and downstream calls are not traced, which makes it hard to spot abuse or failures in serverless flows.

aws.b.lambda.insights_layer.description: For Lambda functions, FAILs when no attached layer ARN contains ':layer:LambdaInsightsExtension:'. Without the Lambda Insights extension, function-level CPU, memory and cold-start telemetry is missing, so resource exhaustion or abuse is harder to see.
aws.b.lambda.insights_layer.pass_when: PASS when a LambdaInsightsExtension layer is attached.
aws.b.lambda.insights_layer.fail_when: FAIL when no LambdaInsightsExtension layer is attached.

aws.b.lambda.reserved_concurrency.description: For Lambda functions, FAILs when GetFunctionConcurrency returns no ReservedConcurrentExecutions value. A function without reserved concurrency can consume the whole regional concurrency pool under a flood, which throttles other functions and amplifies denial-of-wallet attacks.
aws.b.lambda.reserved_concurrency.pass_when: PASS when a ReservedConcurrentExecutions value (including 0) is configured.
aws.b.lambda.reserved_concurrency.fail_when: FAIL when no reserved concurrency is configured.

aws.b.lambda.url_cors_single_wildcard.description: For Lambda functions with a function URL, FAILs when Cors.AllowOrigins is exactly ['*']. A wildcard CORS origin lets any website's JavaScript call the function URL from a victim's browser and read the response.
aws.b.lambda.url_cors_single_wildcard.pass_when: PASS when AllowOrigins is not exactly ['*'] (specific origins or empty).
aws.b.lambda.url_cors_single_wildcard.not_applicable_when: The function has no function URL.

aws.b.mq.automatic_minor_upgrade.description: For Amazon MQ brokers, FAILs when Configuration.AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false. Brokers that are not upgraded automatically keep running ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ versions with known, patched vulnerabilities.

aws.b.neptune.audit_logging.description: For Neptune clusters, FAILs when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports does not include 'audit'. Without exported audit logs, graph queries and connection activity against the database cannot be reviewed for misuse.

aws.b.neptune.backup_retention_seven_day.description: For Neptune clusters, FAILs when BackupRetentionPeriod is below 7 days. Short retention limits point-in-time recovery after data corruption or destructive changes that are noticed late.
aws.b.neptune.backup_retention_seven_day.pass_when: PASS when backupRetentionPeriod is 7 or more.

aws.b.neptune_cluster.deletion_protectio.description: For Neptune clusters, FAILs when DeletionProtection is false. An unprotected cluster can be deleted in one API call, which destroys the graph database.

aws.b.neptune_cluster.iam_authentication.description: For Neptune clusters, FAILs when IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled is false. Without IAM auth, access cannot be tied to IAM identities and short-lived SigV4 credentials, so connectivity relies only on network controls.

aws.b.neptune_cluster.snapshot_tags.description: For Neptune clusters, FAILs when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false. Snapshots without tags lose classification and ownership metadata and escape tag-based access and retention policies.

aws.b.neptune_cluster.storage_encryption.description: For Neptune clusters, FAILs when StorageEncrypted is false. Unencrypted cluster storage, snapshots and replicas expose graph data if storage or snapshots are accessed outside the database.

aws.b.rds.backup_retention_seven_days.description: For RDS DB instances, FAILs when BackupRetentionPeriod is less than 7 (0 means automated backups are disabled). Short or no retention removes point-in-time recovery after corruption, accidental deletes or ransomware.
aws.b.rds.backup_retention_seven_days.pass_when: PASS when backupRetentionPeriod is 7 or more.

aws.b.rds.cluster_event_categories.description: For RDS event subscriptions with SourceType db-cluster, FAILs when the subscription is disabled or its EventCategoriesList lacks any of: failure, maintenance. Without these notifications, cluster failovers and maintenance actions go unnoticed.
aws.b.rds.cluster_event_categories.pass_when: PASS when the db-cluster subscription is enabled and includes all of failure, maintenance.
aws.b.rds.cluster_event_categories.fail_when: FAIL when the subscription is disabled or missing a required category.

aws.b.rds.cluster_minor_upgrade.description: For RDS DB clusters, FAILs when AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false. Clusters that do not take minor engine upgrades keep running versions with known security fixes missing.

aws.b.rds.engine_log_exports.description: For RDS instances, FAILs when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports lacks the engine-specific set: audit/error/general/slowquery for MySQL/MariaDB, postgresql/upgrade for PostgreSQL, alert/audit/trace/listener for Oracle, error (+agent unless sqlserver-ex) for SQL Server. Any other engine always FAILs. Missing exports leave logins, errors and suspicious queries unrecorded outside the instance.
aws.b.rds.engine_log_exports.pass_when: PASS when All log categories required for the instance's engine are exported.
aws.b.rds.engine_log_exports.fail_when: FAIL when a required category is missing, or the engine has no passing branch.

aws.b.rds.instance_event_categories.description: For RDS event subscriptions with SourceType db-instance, FAILs when the subscription is disabled or its EventCategoriesList lacks any of: failure, maintenance, configuration change. Without these notifications, instance failures, maintenance and configuration changes (such as making an instance public) go unnoticed.
aws.b.rds.instance_event_categories.pass_when: PASS when the db-instance subscription is enabled and includes all of failure, maintenance, configuration change.
aws.b.rds.instance_event_categories.fail_when: FAIL when the subscription is disabled or missing a required category.

aws.b.rds.parameter_group_event_categori.description: For RDS event subscriptions with SourceType db-parameter-group, FAILs when the subscription is disabled or its EventCategoriesList lacks any of: configuration change. Without these notifications, changes to parameter groups, such as turning off SSL enforcement or logging, go unnoticed.
aws.b.rds.parameter_group_event_categori.pass_when: PASS when the db-parameter-group subscription is enabled and includes all of configuration change.
aws.b.rds.parameter_group_event_categori.fail_when: FAIL when the subscription is disabled or missing a required category.

aws.b.rds.proxy_tls.description: For RDS Proxies, FAILs when RequireTLS is false. A proxy that accepts plaintext client connections exposes database credentials and query results on the network path.

aws.b.rds.security_group_event_categorie.description: For RDS event subscriptions with SourceType db-security-group, FAILs when the subscription is disabled or its EventCategoriesList lacks any of: configuration change, failure. Without these notifications, changes to or failures of legacy DB security groups go unnoticed.
aws.b.rds.security_group_event_categorie.pass_when: PASS when the db-security-group subscription is enabled and includes all of configuration change, failure.
aws.b.rds.security_group_event_categorie.fail_when: FAIL when the subscription is disabled or missing a required category.

aws.b.rds_cluster.iam_authentication.description: For RDS DB clusters, FAILs when IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled is false. Without IAM database authentication, access depends on long-lived database passwords rather than short-lived IAM tokens that can be audited.

aws.b.rds_cluster.multiple_az.description: For RDS DB clusters, FAILs when MultiAZ is false. Without instances in multiple AZs, an AZ outage or writer failure stops the database because there is no standby to fail over to.

aws.b.rds_cluster.nondefault_admin.description: For RDS DB clusters, FAILs when MasterUsername is 'admin' or 'postgres'. Default master usernames are the first guess in brute-force and credential-stuffing attempts, so only the password protects the admin account.
aws.b.rds_cluster.nondefault_admin.pass_when: PASS when masterUsername is neither 'admin' nor 'postgres'.

aws.b.rds_cluster.nondefault_port_policy.description: For RDS DB clusters, FAILs when the cluster Port is the engine default: 3306 for aurora/mysql/mariadb engines, 5432 for postgres, 1521 for oracle or 1433 for sqlserver. Default ports are what automated internet scanners probe first, so these databases are easier to find.
aws.b.rds_cluster.nondefault_port_policy.pass_when: PASS when the cluster port differs from its engine's default.
aws.b.rds_cluster.nondefault_port_policy.fail_when: FAIL when the cluster listens on its engine's default port.

aws.b.rds_instance.iam_authentication.description: For RDS DB instances, FAILs when IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled is false. Without IAM auth, users connect only with static database passwords, which are harder to rotate, scope and audit than IAM tokens.

aws.b.rds_instance.minor_upgrade.description: For RDS DB instances, FAILs when AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false. Instances without automatic minor upgrades keep running engine versions that are missing published security patches.

aws.b.rds_instance.multiple_az.description: For non-Aurora RDS DB instances, FAILs when MultiAZ is false. A single-AZ instance has no synchronous standby, so a host or AZ failure causes downtime and possible data loss up to the last backup.
aws.b.rds_instance.multiple_az.not_applicable_when: Engine contains aurora-mysql or aurora-postgres (Aurora cluster members).

aws.b.rds_instance.nondefault_admin.description: For RDS DB instances, FAILs when MasterUsername is 'admin' or 'postgres'. Well-known master usernames halve the work of a brute-force attacker, who then only needs the password.
aws.b.rds_instance.nondefault_admin.pass_when: PASS when masterUsername is neither 'admin' nor 'postgres'.

aws.b.rds_instance.nondefault_port_polic.description: For RDS DB instances, FAILs when Endpoint.Port is the engine default (3306 for aurora/mysql/mariadb, 5432 for postgres, 1521 for oracle, 1433 for sqlserver). Default ports make instances trivially discoverable by mass scanners when network controls are weak.
aws.b.rds_instance.nondefault_port_polic.pass_when: PASS when the endpoint port differs from its engine's default.
aws.b.rds_instance.nondefault_port_polic.fail_when: FAIL when the endpoint port is the engine default.

aws.b.rds_instance.snapshot_tags.description: For RDS DB instances, FAILs when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false. Snapshots that do not inherit tags lose data-classification and owner tags, which breaks tag-based access control and retention for backups of sensitive data.

aws.b.redshift.allow_version_upgrade.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when AllowVersionUpgrade is false. The cluster then does not receive engine version upgrades during maintenance windows, so security fixes are delayed.

aws.b.redshift.audit_logging.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when Logging.LoggingEnabled is false. Without audit logging, connection, user-activity and user logs are not delivered, so warehouse access and data exfiltration queries cannot be investigated.

aws.b.redshift.enhanced_vpc_routing.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when EnhancedVpcRouting is false. COPY/UNLOAD traffic then bypasses the VPC, so VPC endpoint policies, security groups and flow logs cannot control or record data movement to S3.

aws.b.redshift.kms_key_declared.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when Encrypted is false, or when an encrypted cluster has no KmsKeyId (established from complete DescribeClusters data). The warehouse data must be encrypted with an identifiable KMS key so that key policy controls access and key usage can be audited.
aws.b.redshift.kms_key_declared.pass_when: PASS when encrypted is true and a KmsKeyId is declared.
aws.b.redshift.kms_key_declared.fail_when: FAIL when encrypted is false, or encrypted without a KmsKeyId.

aws.b.redshift.no_public_endpoint.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when PubliclyAccessible is true. A publicly accessible cluster gets an internet-resolvable endpoint, which exposes the database port to brute-force and exploit attempts.

aws.b.redshift.nondefault_admin.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when MasterUsername is exactly 'awsuser', the console default. A predictable admin username gives attackers half of the superuser credential pair.

aws.b.redshift.nondefault_database.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when DBName is exactly 'dev', the default database name. Default names make targeting and automated attacks against the warehouse easier.

aws.b.redshift.snapshots_seven_days.description: For Redshift clusters, FAILs when AutomatedSnapshotRetentionPeriod is below 7 (0 disables automated snapshots). Short retention limits restoring the warehouse after destructive changes or corruption found later.
aws.b.redshift.snapshots_seven_days.pass_when: PASS when automatedSnapshotRetentionPeriod is 7 or more.

aws.b.ssm.document_not_public.description: For SSM documents owned by the scanned account, FAILs when Permissions.AccountIds contains 'all', i.e. the document is shared publicly. Public documents can expose internal scripts, hostnames, parameters or embedded credentials to every AWS account.
aws.b.ssm.document_not_public.pass_when: PASS when the document's share list does not include 'all'.
aws.b.ssm.document_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when the document is shared with 'all'.
aws.b.ssm.document_not_public.not_applicable_when: Document owned by Amazon/AWS or by another account.

aws.b.ssm.parameter_secure_type.description: For SSM Parameter Store parameters, FAILs when Type is String or StringList instead of SecureString. Non-SecureString values are stored and returned in plaintext, so any secrets kept there are readable by anyone with ssm:GetParameter and appear unencrypted in API responses.
aws.b.ssm.parameter_secure_type.fail_when: FAIL when type is String or StringList.

aws.c2b.acm.in_use_not_expiring_7_days.description: This check fails when an in-use ACM certificate expires within seven days at the captured clock. As a result, clients may soon reject the served certificate.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_not_expiring_7_days.pass_when: PASS when an in-use certificate has more than seven whole days until NotAfter.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_not_expiring_7_days.fail_when: FAIL when an in-use ACM certificate expires within seven days at the captured clock.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_not_expiring_7_days.not_applicable_when: The check is NOT_APPLICABLE when InUseBy is empty or a non-issued certificate has no NotAfter date.

aws.c2b.acm.in_use_secure_key_algorithm.description: This check fails when an in-use ACM certificate declares an algorithm in the evaluator’s insecure-key set. As a result, clients receive weaker certificate identity protection.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_secure_key_algorithm.pass_when: PASS when an in-use certificate's normalized KeyAlgorithm is outside the evaluator's insecure key set.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_secure_key_algorithm.fail_when: FAIL when an in-use ACM certificate declares an algorithm in the evaluator’s insecure-key set.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_secure_key_algorithm.not_applicable_when: The check is NOT_APPLICABLE when the certificate has an empty InUseBy list.

aws.c2b.acm.in_use_transparency_logging.description: This check applies to in-use ACM certificates. Imported certificates pass; other in-use certificates fail unless CertificateTransparencyLoggingPreference is ENABLED.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_transparency_logging.pass_when: PASS when an in-use certificate is imported, or its transparency logging preference is ENABLED.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_transparency_logging.fail_when: FAIL when an in-use non-imported ACM certificate has CertificateTransparencyLoggingPreference DISABLED.
aws.c2b.acm.in_use_transparency_logging.not_applicable_when: The check is NOT_APPLICABLE when the certificate has an empty InUseBy list.

aws.c2b.acmpca.pqc_key_algorithm.description: This check evaluates non-deleted AWS Private CAs and fails when CertificateAuthorityConfiguration.KeyAlgorithm is outside the evaluator's PQC allowlist. A conventional RSA key, including RSA_2048, therefore fails.
aws.c2b.acmpca.pqc_key_algorithm.pass_when: PASS when a non-deleted private CA uses an algorithm in the evaluator's PQC allowlist.
aws.c2b.acmpca.pqc_key_algorithm.fail_when: FAIL when a non-deleted private CA's CertificateAuthorityConfiguration.KeyAlgorithm is outside _PQC.

aws.c2b.acmpca.root_ca_disabled.description: This check applies to ROOT private CAs and fails unless Status is DISABLED. A root CA in ACTIVE state remains able to issue certificates.
aws.c2b.acmpca.root_ca_disabled.pass_when: PASS when a ROOT private CA has Status DISABLED.
aws.c2b.acmpca.root_ca_disabled.fail_when: FAIL when a ROOT private CA's Status is not DISABLED.

aws.c2b.apigateway.authorizers_or_author.description: This REST API check passes with at least one authorizer or with one or more non-OPTIONS methods that all require authorization. Without an authorizer, an API with no non-OPTIONS methods or any method using NONE fails.
aws.c2b.apigateway.authorizers_or_author.pass_when: PASS when the REST API has an authorizer, or it has at least one non-OPTIONS method and every such method uses authorizationType other than NONE.
aws.c2b.apigateway.authorizers_or_author.fail_when: FAIL when no authorizer exists and there are no non-OPTIONS methods, or any such method has authorizationType NONE.

aws.c2b.apigateway.domain_pqc_tls.description: This API Gateway domain check fails when securityPolicy is outside the configured APIGW_PQC policy set. The check compares the declared TLS policy and does not attempt a connection.
aws.c2b.apigateway.domain_pqc_tls.pass_when: PASS when the API Gateway domain securityPolicy is in APIGW_PQC.
aws.c2b.apigateway.domain_pqc_tls.fail_when: FAIL when an API Gateway domain securityPolicy is outside APIGW_PQC.

aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_authorization.description: This check fails when any REST API method declares authorizationType NONE. As a result, the method can be invoked without method authorization.
aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_authorization.pass_when: PASS when Every REST API method has authorizationType other than NONE.
aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_authorization.fail_when: FAIL when any REST API method declares authorizationType NONE.
aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_authorization.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not methods`.

aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_request_valid.description: This check fails when any REST API method has no requestValidatorId. As a result, malformed or unexpected requests may reach the integration.
aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_request_valid.pass_when: PASS when Every REST API method has a requestValidatorId.
aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_request_valid.fail_when: FAIL when any REST API method has no requestValidatorId.
aws.c2b.apigateway.methods_request_valid.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not methods`.

aws.c2b.apigateway.public_rest_api_autho.description: This check fails when a non-private REST API has an empty Authorizers inventory. As a result, public callers may have no API authorizer to challenge them.
aws.c2b.apigateway.public_rest_api_autho.pass_when: PASS when a REST API whose endpoint types are not exactly ['PRIVATE'] has at least one authorizer.
aws.c2b.apigateway.public_rest_api_autho.fail_when: FAIL when a non-private REST API has an empty Authorizers inventory.

aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_has_authoriz.description: This check fails when a REST API has an empty Authorizers inventory. As a result, methods may lack a reusable identity authorizer.
aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_has_authoriz.pass_when: PASS when the REST API Authorizers inventory is nonempty.
aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_has_authoriz.fail_when: FAIL when a REST API has an empty Authorizers inventory.

aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_policy_not_p.description: This REST API check inspects the resource policy for a public Allow statement with a wildcard principal under the evaluator's perimeter predicate. A missing policy or one without a selected public statement passes.
aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_policy_not_p.pass_when: PASS when the REST API has no policy, or its policy has no wildcard-principal Allow statement selected by the evaluator.
aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_policy_not_p.fail_when: FAIL when a REST API policy contains a wildcard-principal public Allow statement selected by the evaluator.

aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_private_only.description: This REST API check requires endpointConfiguration.types to equal the single-element list ['PRIVATE']. EDGE, REGIONAL, or a mixed list fails.
aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_private_only.pass_when: PASS when the REST API endpoint types are exactly ['PRIVATE'].
aws.c2b.apigateway.rest_api_private_only.fail_when: FAIL when rEST API endpoint types are not exactly ['PRIVATE'].

aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_cache_encrypted.description: This stage check applies when at least one method setting enables caching. It fails only if none of the selected caching settings has cacheDataEncrypted true.
aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_cache_encrypted.pass_when: PASS when at least one enabled stage caching method setting has cacheDataEncrypted true.
aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_cache_encrypted.fail_when: FAIL when stage caching is enabled and none of the selected method settings has cacheDataEncrypted true.
aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_cache_encrypted.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not caching`.

aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_execution_loggi.description: This check fails when a REST API stage has execution logging set to OFF. As a result, suspicious calls may lack stage execution evidence.
aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_execution_loggi.pass_when: PASS when at least one REST API stage method setting has a nonempty logging level other than OFF.
aws.c2b.apigateway.stage_execution_loggi.fail_when: FAIL when a REST API stage has execution logging set to OFF.

aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.api_has_authorizer.description: This check fails when an HTTP API has an empty Authorizers inventory. As a result, routes may lack a configured JWT or Lambda authorizer.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.api_has_authorizer.pass_when: PASS when the HTTP API Authorizers inventory is nonempty.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.api_has_authorizer.fail_when: FAIL when an HTTP API has an empty Authorizers inventory.

aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizatio.description: This check fails when any HTTP API route has AuthorizationType NONE. As a result, the route can be called without an authorizer.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizatio.pass_when: PASS when Every HTTP API route has AuthorizationType other than NONE.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizatio.fail_when: FAIL when any HTTP API route has AuthorizationType NONE.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizatio.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not routes`.

aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizer.description: This check fails when any HTTP API route lacks an AuthorizerId. As a result, the route can accept calls without its intended identity check.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizer.pass_when: PASS when Every HTTP API route has an AuthorizerId.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizer.fail_when: FAIL when any HTTP API route lacks an AuthorizerId.
aws.c2b.apigatewayv2.routes_authorizer.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not routes`.

aws.c2b.appstream.disconnect_timeout_5m.description: For AppStream 2.0 fleets, FAILs when DisconnectTimeoutInSeconds is greater than 300. A long disconnect window keeps a streaming session, with the user's open apps and data, resumable for a long time after the user drops off, so someone else can reconnect to an unattended session.
aws.c2b.appstream.disconnect_timeout_5m.pass_when: PASS when disconnectTimeoutInSeconds is 300 or less.
aws.c2b.appstream.disconnect_timeout_5m.fail_when: FAIL when disconnectTimeoutInSeconds is greater than 300.

aws.c2b.appstream.idle_disconnect_10m.description: For AppStream 2.0 fleets, FAILs unless IdleDisconnectTimeoutInSeconds is between 1 and 600; 0 or an omitted value (idle disconnect turned off) FAILs. Without a short idle disconnect, sessions left idle on unattended devices stay active and usable by anyone at the keyboard.
aws.c2b.appstream.idle_disconnect_10m.pass_when: PASS when idleDisconnectTimeoutInSeconds is greater than 0 and 600 or less.
aws.c2b.appstream.idle_disconnect_10m.fail_when: FAIL when idleDisconnectTimeoutInSeconds is 0, unset, or above 600.

aws.c2b.appstream.max_user_duration_unde.description: For AppStream 2.0 fleets, FAILs when MaxUserDurationInSeconds is 36000 (10 hours) or more. Very long maximum sessions extend how long a hijacked or unattended streaming session stays valid without re-authentication.
aws.c2b.appstream.max_user_duration_unde.fail_when: FAIL when maxUserDurationInSeconds is 36000 or more.

aws.c2b.appstream.no_default_internet.description: For AppStream 2.0 fleets, FAILs when EnableDefaultInternetAccess is true (an omitted value counts as false). Default internet access gives streaming instances direct public egress, which bypasses NAT/proxy egress controls and makes data exfiltration and malware download easy.
aws.c2b.appstream.no_default_internet.pass_when: PASS when enableDefaultInternetAccess is false or omitted.

aws.c2b.appsync.cache_at_rest_encryption.description: This AppSync check applies to an API with a configured cache and fails when ApiCache.apiCache.atRestEncryptionEnabled is false. An API with no cache is not applicable.
aws.c2b.appsync.cache_at_rest_encryption.pass_when: PASS when a configured AppSync API cache has atRestEncryptionEnabled true.
aws.c2b.appsync.cache_at_rest_encryption.fail_when: FAIL when a configured AppSync API cache has atRestEncryptionEnabled false.
aws.c2b.appsync.cache_at_rest_encryption.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `cache is None`.

aws.c2b.appsync.cache_in_transit_encrypt.description: This AppSync check applies to an API with a configured cache and fails when ApiCache.apiCache.transitEncryptionEnabled is false. An API with no cache is not applicable.
aws.c2b.appsync.cache_in_transit_encrypt.pass_when: PASS when a configured AppSync API cache has transitEncryptionEnabled true.
aws.c2b.appsync.cache_in_transit_encrypt.fail_when: FAIL when a configured AppSync API cache has transitEncryptionEnabled false.
aws.c2b.appsync.cache_in_transit_encrypt.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `cache is None`.

aws.c2b.appsync.field_level_logging.description: This AppSync API check requires logConfig.fieldLogLevel to be ALL or ERROR. NONE or an unset level fails because field-level activity is not logged by that configuration.
aws.c2b.appsync.field_level_logging.pass_when: PASS when the AppSync logConfig.fieldLogLevel is ALL or ERROR.
aws.c2b.appsync.field_level_logging.fail_when: FAIL when logConfig.fieldLogLevel is neither ALL nor ERROR.

aws.c2b.appsync.graphql_no_api_key.description: This check fails when a GRAPHQL AppSync API uses API_KEY as its default authentication type. As a result, a leaked API key can grant access without a user identity.
aws.c2b.appsync.graphql_no_api_key.pass_when: PASS when a GRAPHQL AppSync API has a default authentication type other than API_KEY.
aws.c2b.appsync.graphql_no_api_key.fail_when: FAIL when a GRAPHQL AppSync API uses API_KEY as its default authentication type.

aws.c2b.appsync.no_api_key_auth.description: This check fails when an AppSync API of any apiType uses API_KEY as its default authentication type. As a result, a shared key can be copied and used to query protected data.
aws.c2b.appsync.no_api_key_auth.pass_when: PASS when the AppSync API default authentication type is other than API_KEY.
aws.c2b.appsync.no_api_key_auth.fail_when: FAIL when an AppSync API of any apiType uses API_KEY as its default authentication type.

aws.c2b.athena.cloudwatch_metrics.description: For every Athena workgroup, whatever its state, FAILs when Configuration.PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled is false or omitted. Without per-workgroup query metrics, abnormal query volume or data-scanned spikes (possible bulk exfiltration or runaway cost) are not visible in CloudWatch.
aws.c2b.athena.cloudwatch_metrics.fail_when: FAIL when publishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled is false or omitted (DISABLED workgroups included).

aws.c2b.athena.cloudwatch_metrics_prowle.description: Prowler variant evaluated only for ENABLED Athena workgroups: FAILs when PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled is false or omitted. Active workgroups that publish no metrics give no signal of unusual query activity or data scanning.
aws.c2b.athena.cloudwatch_metrics_prowle.pass_when: PASS when the enabled workgroup publishes CloudWatch metrics.
aws.c2b.athena.cloudwatch_metrics_prowle.fail_when: FAIL when the enabled workgroup has PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled false or omitted.

aws.c2b.athena.enforce_configuration.description: For every Athena workgroup, FAILs when Configuration.EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration is false or omitted. Without enforcement, clients can override the workgroup's result location and encryption settings, for example writing unencrypted query results to an arbitrary bucket.
aws.c2b.athena.enforce_configuration.fail_when: FAIL when enforceWorkGroupConfiguration is false or omitted (any workgroup state).

aws.c2b.athena.enforce_configuration_pro.description: Prowler variant evaluated only for ENABLED Athena workgroups: FAILs when EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration is false or omitted. Client-side settings can then override result encryption and output location for queries in active workgroups.
aws.c2b.athena.enforce_configuration_pro.pass_when: PASS when the enabled workgroup enforces its configuration.
aws.c2b.athena.enforce_configuration_pro.fail_when: FAIL when the enabled workgroup does not enforce its configuration.

aws.c2b.athena.results_encrypted.description: For every Athena workgroup, FAILs unless managed query results are enabled or ResultConfiguration.EncryptionConfiguration.EncryptionOption is SSE_S3, SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS. Unencrypted query results in S3 can hold copies of sensitive data pulled from the data lake.
aws.c2b.athena.results_encrypted.pass_when: PASS when managed query results are enabled, or the encryption option is SSE_S3/SSE_KMS/CSE_KMS.
aws.c2b.athena.results_encrypted.fail_when: FAIL when neither managed query results nor a recognized encryption option is configured.

aws.c2b.athena.results_encrypted_prowler.description: Prowler variant for ENABLED Athena workgroups: FAILs when ResultConfiguration.EncryptionConfiguration.EncryptionOption is not SSE_S3, SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS. Managed query results are not counted as passing. Unencrypted result files in the output bucket expose queried data.
aws.c2b.athena.results_encrypted_prowler.pass_when: PASS when the enabled workgroup declares an SSE_S3, SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS result encryption option.
aws.c2b.athena.results_encrypted_prowler.fail_when: FAIL when no result encryption option is configured (even if managed query results are on).

aws.c2b.autoscaling.capacity_rebalance.description: For Auto Scaling groups attached to both classic load balancers and target groups, FAILs when CapacityRebalance is false or omitted. Without capacity rebalancing, Spot instances that get an interruption notice are not replaced in advance, which reduces capacity behind the load balancers.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.capacity_rebalance.fail_when: FAIL when capacityRebalance is false or omitted.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.capacity_rebalance.not_applicable_when: The group lacks either classic load balancers or target groups.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.elb_health_check.description: For Auto Scaling groups attached to any classic load balancer or target group, FAILs when HealthCheckType does not include ELB. With EC2-only health checks, instances whose application fails load balancer health checks stay in service and are not replaced.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.elb_health_check.fail_when: FAIL when healthCheckType does not include ELB (e.g. EC2).
aws.c2b.autoscaling.elb_health_check.not_applicable_when: The group has no classic load balancers and no target groups.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_imdsv2.description: For Auto Scaling groups that use a launch configuration, joins it from the launch configuration inventory and FAILs when MetadataOptions.HttpTokens is not 'required' while the metadata endpoint is enabled. Instances launched with IMDSv1 allowed let SSRF bugs read instance-role credentials from the metadata service.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_imdsv2.pass_when: PASS when the joined launch configuration has HttpTokens required, or HttpEndpoint disabled.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_imdsv2.fail_when: FAIL when httpEndpoint is enabled and HttpTokens is optional.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_imdsv2.not_applicable_when: The group does not use a launch configuration (launch template or mixed instances policy).

aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_no_public_i.description: For Auto Scaling groups that use a launch configuration, FAILs when the joined launch configuration has AssociatePublicIpAddress true. Every instance the group launches then gets a public IP, which exposes it directly to internet scanning and attack if security groups are permissive.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_no_public_i.pass_when: PASS when the joined launch configuration's AssociatePublicIpAddress is false or omitted.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.group_lc_no_public_i.not_applicable_when: The group does not use a launch configuration.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.instance_types_per_a.description: For Auto Scaling groups with running instances, groups instances by AvailabilityZone and FAILs when they span fewer than two zones or when any zone runs fewer than two distinct instance types. Relying on one instance type per zone makes the group vulnerable to capacity shortages or Spot interruptions of that type.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.instance_types_per_a.pass_when: PASS when instances run in two or more zones and each zone has two or more instance types.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.instance_types_per_a.fail_when: FAIL when only one zone is in use, or some zone runs a single instance type.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.instance_types_per_a.not_applicable_when: The group has no running instances.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.lc_hop_limit.description: For launch configurations, FAILs when MetadataOptions.HttpPutResponseHopLimit is set above 1 (unset passes as the default of 1). A hop limit above 1 lets containers or forwarded traffic on the instance reach IMDSv2 tokens and steal instance-role credentials.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.lc_hop_limit.pass_when: PASS when hop limit is unset or 1.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.lc_hop_limit.fail_when: FAIL when hop limit is greater than 1.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.lc_imdsv2_required.description: For launch configurations, FAILs when MetadataOptions.HttpTokens is set to anything other than 'required' (unset is UNKNOWN because account IMDS defaults may apply). Allowing IMDSv1 lets server-side request forgery read IAM role credentials from instances launched from this configuration.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.lc_no_public_ip.description: For each launch configuration (whether or not a group uses it), FAILs when AssociatePublicIpAddress is true (an omitted value counts as false). Instances launched from it get public IPv4 addresses and are directly internet-reachable.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.lc_no_public_ip.pass_when: PASS when associatePublicIpAddress is false or omitted.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.mixed_policy_multipl.description: For Auto Scaling groups, FAILs when the MixedInstancesPolicy launch-template Overrides declare fewer than two distinct InstanceType values. Groups without any mixed instances policy also FAIL, and attribute-based overrides are UNKNOWN. Single-type groups are more exposed to capacity shortages and Spot reclamation of that type.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.mixed_policy_multipl.pass_when: PASS when overrides list two or more distinct instance types.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.mixed_policy_multipl.fail_when: FAIL when fewer than two distinct override instance types, or no mixed instances policy.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.multiple_az.description: For Auto Scaling groups, FAILs when AvailabilityZones has fewer than two entries. A group pinned to a single AZ cannot replace capacity in another zone when that AZ fails.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.multiple_az.pass_when: PASS when two or more availability zones are configured.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.multiple_az.fail_when: FAIL when only one availability zone is configured.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.no_suspended_process.description: For Auto Scaling groups, FAILs when SuspendedProcesses is non-empty (for example Launch, Terminate, HealthCheck or ReplaceUnhealthy suspended). Suspended processes silently stop scaling or the replacement of unhealthy instances, so failures are no longer self-healed.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.no_suspended_process.pass_when: PASS when no processes are suspended.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.no_suspended_process.fail_when: FAIL when one or more scaling processes are suspended.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.tags_propagate.description: For Auto Scaling groups, FAILs when any group tag has PropagateAtLaunch false; groups with no tags pass. Instances launched without the group's tags lose ownership/environment metadata that tag-based IAM conditions, cost allocation and incident triage rely on.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.tags_propagate.pass_when: PASS when Every tag propagates at launch (or there are no tags).
aws.c2b.autoscaling.tags_propagate.fail_when: FAIL when at least one tag has PropagateAtLaunch false.

aws.c2b.autoscaling.uses_launch_template.description: For Auto Scaling groups, FAILs when neither a LaunchTemplate nor a MixedInstancesPolicy launch template specification is set, i.e. the group uses a legacy launch configuration. Launch configurations are deprecated and cannot use newer security features such as IMDSv2 defaults and the latest instance types.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.uses_launch_template.pass_when: PASS when a launch template is set directly or through the mixed instances policy.
aws.c2b.autoscaling.uses_launch_template.fail_when: FAIL when no launch template is referenced (launch configuration only).

aws.c2b.backup.plan_rules_retention_35.description: For each AWS Backup plan, FAILs when any rule's Lifecycle.DeleteAfterDays is set below 35. Rules with no expiration pass. Short retention means recovery points are already gone when ransomware or corruption is discovered weeks later.
aws.c2b.backup.plan_rules_retention_35.pass_when: PASS when Every rule either never expires or has DeleteAfterDays of 35 or more.
aws.c2b.backup.plan_rules_retention_35.fail_when: FAIL when at least one rule has DeleteAfterDays below 35.
aws.c2b.backup.plan_rules_retention_35.not_applicable_when: The backup plan has no rules.

aws.c2b.backup.plans_exist_when_vaults.description: Scope-level regional check that FAILs when the region has at least one AWS Backup vault but no backup plan. Vaults with no plan mean no scheduled backups are actually being taken into them, which gives a false sense of recoverability.
aws.c2b.backup.plans_exist_when_vaults.pass_when: PASS when at least one backup plan exists in the region.
aws.c2b.backup.plans_exist_when_vaults.fail_when: FAIL when no backup plan exists while one or more vaults exist.
aws.c2b.backup.plans_exist_when_vaults.not_applicable_when: The region has neither backup plans nor vaults.

aws.c2b.backup.recovery_point_encrypted.description: For each AWS Backup recovery point, FAILs when IsEncrypted is false. Unencrypted recovery points, for example copied from unencrypted sources, expose full copies of production data to anyone who can restore or copy them.

aws.c2b.backup.recovery_point_retention_.description: For each AWS Backup recovery point, FAILs when Lifecycle.DeleteAfterDays is set below 35 (no expiration passes). Recovery points that expire quickly may not exist anymore when you need to roll back a compromise discovered late.
aws.c2b.backup.recovery_point_retention_.pass_when: PASS when deleteAfterDays is unset or 35 or more.

aws.c2b.backup.report_plans_when_plans.description: Scope-level regional check evaluated only when backup plans exist: FAILs when there is no AWS Backup report plan. Without report plans, failed backup jobs and policy non-compliance are not reported for audit.
aws.c2b.backup.report_plans_when_plans.pass_when: PASS when backup plans exist and at least one report plan exists.
aws.c2b.backup.report_plans_when_plans.fail_when: FAIL when backup plans exist and no report plan exists.
aws.c2b.backup.report_plans_when_plans.not_applicable_when: The region has no backup plans.

aws.c2b.backup.vault_encrypted.description: Checks matching valid Backup vault EncryptionKeyArn metadata from ListBackupVaults or DescribeBackupVault. A configured vault key does not prove encryption of every recovery point. Remediation: Review matching vault key metadata and each recovery point before changing backup encryption; an absent list key does not prove plaintext backup.
aws.c2b.backup.vault_encrypted.pass_when: A matching valid vault KMS key ARN is observed.
aws.c2b.backup.vault_encrypted.fail_when: No documented unencrypted-vault state is asserted as FAIL; missing, denied, conflicting or malformed key metadata is UNKNOWN.

aws.c2b.backup.vault_policy_denies_recov.description: For each AWS Backup vault, FAILs unless the vault access policy has a Deny statement on Resource '*' whose actions (wildcards allowed) cover backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint, backup:UpdateRecoveryPointLifecycle and backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy. Vaults with no policy FAIL. Without that deny, a compromised admin can delete or shorten backups before deploying ransomware.
aws.c2b.backup.vault_policy_denies_recov.pass_when: PASS when a Deny statement on '*' covers all three recovery-point protection actions.
aws.c2b.backup.vault_policy_denies_recov.fail_when: FAIL when no such Deny statement exists, or the vault has no access policy.

aws.c2b.backup.vault_policy_not_public.description: For each AWS Backup vault, FAILs when the vault access policy has an Allow statement with a wildcard principal and no restricting condition (such as source account/org/ARN). A public vault policy lets any AWS account act on the vault, for example copying recovery points in or out.
aws.c2b.backup.vault_policy_not_public.pass_when: PASS when no unconditioned wildcard-principal Allow statement exists, or there is no policy.
aws.c2b.backup.vault_policy_not_public.fail_when: FAIL when an Allow statement grants a wildcard principal without a restricting condition.

aws.c2b.bedrock.agent_guardrail.description: This check fails when a Bedrock agent has no guardrailConfiguration.guardrailIdentifier. As a result, model interactions may run without the intended guardrail.
aws.c2b.bedrock.agent_guardrail.pass_when: PASS when the Bedrock agent has a nonempty guardrailConfiguration.guardrailIdentifier.
aws.c2b.bedrock.agent_guardrail.fail_when: FAIL when a Bedrock agent has no guardrailConfiguration.guardrailIdentifier.

aws.c2b.bedrock.api_key_long_term_expire.description: This check fails when a Bedrock service-specific credential has an ExpirationDate later than the captured clock. As a result, a long-term API key remains usable if copied.
aws.c2b.bedrock.api_key_long_term_expire.pass_when: PASS when the Bedrock service-specific credential's ExpirationDate is at or before the captured clock.
aws.c2b.bedrock.api_key_long_term_expire.fail_when: FAIL when a Bedrock service-specific credential has an ExpirationDate later than the captured clock.
aws.c2b.bedrock.api_key_long_term_expire.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `service != 'bedrock.amazonaws.com'` or `not expiry`.

aws.c2b.bedrock.custom_model_cmk.description: This check fails when a Bedrock custom model has no Model.modelKmsKeyArn. As a result, stored model weights lack a customer-managed encryption key.
aws.c2b.bedrock.custom_model_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the Bedrock custom model declares a nonempty Model.modelKmsKeyArn.
aws.c2b.bedrock.custom_model_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when a Bedrock custom model has no Model.modelKmsKeyArn.

aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_contextual_gro.description: This check fails when a guardrail lacks an enabled BLOCK grounding or relevance filter at the required threshold. As a result, unsupported or irrelevant model answers may pass the guardrail.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_contextual_gro.pass_when: PASS when both GROUNDING and RELEVANCE filters are present, enabled, use BLOCK, and have thresholds greater than zero.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_contextual_gro.fail_when: FAIL when a guardrail lacks an enabled BLOCK grounding or relevance filter at the required threshold.

aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_prompt_attack_.description: This Bedrock guardrail check requires a PROMPT_ATTACK content filter with inputStrength HIGH. A missing filter or a lower strength fails.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_prompt_attack_.pass_when: PASS when the PROMPT_ATTACK filter's inputStrength is HIGH.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_prompt_attack_.fail_when: FAIL when no PROMPT_ATTACK filter exists or its inputStrength is not HIGH.

aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_sensitive_info.description: This check fails when a Bedrock guardrail has no sensitiveInformationPolicy. As a result, sensitive inputs or outputs may not be filtered.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_sensitive_info.pass_when: PASS when the Bedrock guardrail has a sensitiveInformationPolicy object.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrail_sensitive_info.fail_when: FAIL when a Bedrock guardrail has no sensitiveInformationPolicy.

aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrails_configured.description: This check fails when the regional Bedrock guardrail inventory is empty. As a result, Bedrock workloads have no discovered guardrail to attach.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrails_configured.pass_when: PASS when the regional Bedrock guardrail inventory is nonempty.
aws.c2b.bedrock.guardrails_configured.fail_when: FAIL when the regional Bedrock guardrail inventory is empty.

aws.c2b.bedrock.invocation_logs_encrypte.description: This scope check tests encryption on Bedrock invocation-log destinations found in complete same-account bucket and log-group inventories. A declared destination missing from those inventories is ignored by this predicate.
aws.c2b.bedrock.invocation_logs_encrypte.pass_when: PASS when for enabled invocation logging, each destination found in the complete inventory has S3 default encryption or a CloudWatch log group KMS key, respectively; absent inventory matches do not fail.
aws.c2b.bedrock.invocation_logs_encrypte.fail_when: FAIL when a matching S3 destination bucket lacks an Encryption fact or a matching CloudWatch log group lacks kmsKeyId.
aws.c2b.bedrock.invocation_logs_encrypte.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not config`.

aws.c2b.bedrock.knowledge_base_data_sour.description: This check fails when any knowledge-base data source lacks serverSideEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyArn. As a result, ingested source data lacks a declared customer-managed encryption key.
aws.c2b.bedrock.knowledge_base_data_sour.pass_when: PASS when Every knowledge-base data source has serverSideEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyArn.
aws.c2b.bedrock.knowledge_base_data_sour.fail_when: FAIL when any knowledge-base data source lacks serverSideEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyArn.
aws.c2b.bedrock.knowledge_base_data_sour.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not sources`.

aws.c2b.bedrock.model_invocation_logging.description: This check fails when regional loggingConfig has neither cloudWatchConfig nor s3Config. As a result, model invocations may leave no audit record.
aws.c2b.bedrock.model_invocation_logging.pass_when: PASS when the regional loggingConfig has cloudWatchConfig or s3Config.
aws.c2b.bedrock.model_invocation_logging.fail_when: FAIL when regional loggingConfig has neither cloudWatchConfig nor s3Config.

aws.c2b.bedrock.prompt_cmk.description: This check fails when a Bedrock prompt has no Prompt.customerEncryptionKeyArn. As a result, stored prompt content lacks a customer-managed encryption key.
aws.c2b.bedrock.prompt_cmk.pass_when: PASS when the Bedrock prompt declares a nonempty Prompt.customerEncryptionKeyArn.
aws.c2b.bedrock.prompt_cmk.fail_when: FAIL when a Bedrock prompt has no Prompt.customerEncryptionKeyArn.

aws.c2b.bedrock.prompt_management_exists.description: This check fails when the regional Bedrock prompt inventory is empty. As a result, prompt versions and approvals have no discovered managed home.
aws.c2b.bedrock.prompt_management_exists.pass_when: PASS when the regional Bedrock prompt inventory is nonempty.
aws.c2b.bedrock.prompt_management_exists.fail_when: FAIL when the regional Bedrock prompt inventory is empty.

aws.c2b.bedrock.role_no_full_access_poli.description: This check fails when a non-service IAM role attaches AmazonBedrockFullAccess. As a result, role sessions can exercise broad Bedrock actions.
aws.c2b.bedrock.role_no_full_access_poli.pass_when: PASS when a non-service IAM role does not attach AmazonBedrockFullAccess.
aws.c2b.bedrock.role_no_full_access_poli.fail_when: FAIL when a non-service IAM role attaches AmazonBedrockFullAccess.

aws.c2b.bedrock.vpc_endpoints.description: This check fails when Bedrock activity exists in a region with network interfaces but required Bedrock VPC endpoint services are missing. As a result, model traffic may leave the intended private network path.
aws.c2b.bedrock.vpc_endpoints.pass_when: PASS when for a VPC with network interfaces in a region with Bedrock activity, all required Bedrock endpoint services are present.
aws.c2b.bedrock.vpc_endpoints.fail_when: FAIL when bedrock activity exists in a region with network interfaces but required Bedrock VPC endpoint services are missing.
aws.c2b.bedrock.vpc_endpoints.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not any((get(e, 'VpcId', str) == vpc_id for e in complete_items(index, 'network_interface') if 'VpcId' in e))` or `not _br_active(index)`.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.acm_certificates.description: This check examines HTTPS and SSL listeners on a classic ELB that declare certificate references. It fails when a referenced certificate is absent from the ACM inventory or its Type is not AMAZON_ISSUED.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.acm_certificates.pass_when: PASS when every referenced HTTPS or SSL listener certificate is found in the ACM inventory with Type AMAZON_ISSUED, or when there are no such references.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.acm_certificates.fail_when: FAIL when any referenced HTTPS or SSL listener certificate is missing from ACM inventory or is not AMAZON_ISSUED.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.has_registered_insta.description: This check fails when a classic load balancer has an empty Instances list. As a result, the balancer has no registered backend to serve requests.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.has_registered_insta.pass_when: PASS when the classic ELB Instances list is nonempty.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.has_registered_insta.fail_when: FAIL when a classic load balancer has an empty Instances list.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.insecure_ssl_ciphers.description: For HTTPS listeners on a classic ELB, this check requires the named ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01 policy. It fails when any HTTPS listener lacks that exact PolicyNames entry; it does not inspect individual ciphers.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.insecure_ssl_ciphers.pass_when: PASS when every HTTPS listener has ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01 in PolicyNames, including when there are no HTTPS listeners.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.insecure_ssl_ciphers.fail_when: FAIL when any HTTPS listener lacks ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01 in PolicyNames.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.not_internet_facing.description: This classic ELB check fails when Scheme is internet-facing. It compares the declared scheme and does not test reachability.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.not_internet_facing.pass_when: PASS when the classic ELB Scheme is internal rather than internet-facing.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.not_internet_facing.fail_when: FAIL when the classic ELB Scheme is internet-facing.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.sg_inbound_rule.description: This check fails when a classic ELB has no security group or any joined group has an empty IpPermissions list. As a result, legitimate clients may be unable to reach the listener.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.sg_inbound_rule.pass_when: PASS when the classic ELB has security groups and each joined group has a nonempty IpPermissions list.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.sg_inbound_rule.fail_when: FAIL when a classic ELB has no security group or any joined group has an empty IpPermissions list.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.sg_outbound_rule.description: This check fails when a classic ELB has no security group or any joined group has an empty IpPermissionsEgress list. As a result, the balancer may be unable to reach backend instances.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.sg_outbound_rule.pass_when: PASS when the classic ELB has security groups and each joined group has a nonempty IpPermissionsEgress list.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.sg_outbound_rule.fail_when: FAIL when a classic ELB has no security group or any joined group has an empty IpPermissionsEgress list.

aws.c2b.classic_elb.ssl_listeners_only.description: This classic ELB check examines listener Protocol values and fails for any value other than HTTPS or SSL. A load balancer with no listeners passes.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.ssl_listeners_only.pass_when: PASS when every classic ELB listener Protocol is HTTPS or SSL, including an empty listener list.
aws.c2b.classic_elb.ssl_listeners_only.fail_when: FAIL when any classic ELB listener Protocol is neither HTTPS nor SSL.

aws.c2b.cloudformation.cdktoolkit_bootst.description: This check applies only to a CDKToolkit stack with a parsed bootstrap version output. A version below 21 fails; other stack names or a missing version are not applicable.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.cdktoolkit_bootst.pass_when: PASS when a CDKToolkit stack has a parsed bootstrap version of at least 21.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.cdktoolkit_bootst.fail_when: FAIL when a CDKToolkit stack has a parsed bootstrap version below 21.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.cdktoolkit_bootst.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `name != 'CDKToolkit'` or `not version`.

aws.c2b.cloudformation.drift_in_sync.description: This CloudFormation check evaluates stacks with drift status IN_SYNC or DRIFTED. DRIFTED fails, while other statuses are not applicable.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.drift_in_sync.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFormation stack's drift status is IN_SYNC.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.drift_in_sync.fail_when: FAIL when the CloudFormation stack drift status is DRIFTED.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.drift_in_sync.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `status not in ('IN_SYNC', 'DRIFTED')`.

aws.c2b.cloudformation.notifications.description: This check fails when a CloudFormation stack has an empty NotificationARNs list. As a result, stack failures and changes may not notify an owner.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.notifications.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFormation stack has at least one NotificationARNs entry.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.notifications.fail_when: FAIL when a CloudFormation stack has an empty NotificationARNs list.

aws.c2b.cloudformation.rollback_enabled.description: This CloudFormation check fails when DisableRollback is true. A stack with rollback enabled passes.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.rollback_enabled.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFormation stack has DisableRollback false.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.rollback_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when the CloudFormation stack has DisableRollback true.

aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.description: This check fails when any CloudFormation stack has EnableTerminationProtection false. As a result, the stack can be deleted accidentally or by a compromised principal.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFormation stack has EnableTerminationProtection true.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.fail_when: FAIL when any CloudFormation stack has EnableTerminationProtection false.

aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.description: This check fails when a root CloudFormation stack has EnableTerminationProtection false. As a result, deleting the root stack can remove an entire deployment.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.pass_when: PASS when a root CloudFormation stack has EnableTerminationProtection true.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.fail_when: FAIL when a root CloudFormation stack has EnableTerminationProtection false.
aws.c2b.cloudformation.termination_prote.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when RootId is nonempty, identifying a nested stack; root stacks have an empty RootId and are evaluated.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.custom_ssl_certificat.description: This check fails when a CloudFront distribution uses the default CloudFront viewer certificate. As a result, a custom domain may lack its intended certificate identity.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.custom_ssl_certificat.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFront distribution has CloudFrontDefaultCertificate false.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.custom_ssl_certificat.fail_when: FAIL when a CloudFront distribution uses the default CloudFront viewer certificate.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.default_behavior_http.description: This check fails when a CloudFront default cache behavior allows HTTP viewers. As a result, viewer requests and responses can traverse plaintext links.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.default_behavior_http.pass_when: PASS when the default cache behavior ViewerProtocolPolicy is not allow-all.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.default_behavior_http.fail_when: FAIL when a CloudFront default cache behavior allows HTTP viewers.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.https_sni.description: This check fails when a custom-certificate CloudFront distribution has SSLSupportMethod other than sni-only. As a result, clients may be served through an outdated TLS support mode.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.https_sni.pass_when: PASS when a custom-certificate CloudFront distribution has SSLSupportMethod sni-only.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.https_sni.fail_when: FAIL when a custom-certificate CloudFront distribution has SSLSupportMethod other than sni-only.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.https_sni.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not reference`.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.logging_any.description: This CloudFront check accepts standard logging, a real-time log configuration, or a matching v2 log delivery. It fails only when all three are absent.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.logging_any.pass_when: PASS when the CloudFront distribution has standard logging, a real-time log configuration, or at least one v2 log delivery.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.logging_any.fail_when: FAIL when the distribution has no standard logging, no real-time log configuration, and no v2 log deliveries.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.origin_no_deprecated_.description: This check fails when a custom CloudFront origin permits a deprecated SSL or TLS protocol. As a result, edge-to-origin traffic can negotiate obsolete cryptography.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.origin_no_deprecated_.pass_when: PASS when no custom origin declares a protocol in the evaluator's deprecated SSL/TLS set.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.origin_no_deprecated_.fail_when: FAIL when a custom CloudFront origin permits a deprecated SSL or TLS protocol.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.origin_traffic_encryp.description: Evaluates each used CloudFront default and additional cache behavior against its directly targeted origin. A proven custom http-only route, custom match-viewer route with allow-all viewers, or S3 route with allow-all viewers fails. Ambiguous target binding, incomplete used evidence, and unmodeled origin groups yield UNKNOWN unless another used route is definitely insecure. The S3 viewer-policy rule retains pinned source parity and can flag an OAC always-signing path that uses HTTPS.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.origin_traffic_encryp.pass_when: PASS when every used behavior binds unambiguously to a directly targeted origin with complete secure evidence: custom https-only, custom match-viewer with HTTPS-only or redirect-to-https viewers, or S3 with viewers other than allow-all. Unused origins do not affect PASS.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.origin_traffic_encryp.fail_when: FAIL when any proven used direct custom origin is http-only, any proven used direct custom match-viewer origin has allow-all viewers, or any proven used direct S3 origin has allow-all viewers, even if unrelated behavior evidence is incomplete.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.pqc_tls.description: This check fails when a distribution uses the default viewer certificate or a MinimumProtocolVersion outside the evaluator’s PQC policy set. As a result, viewer TLS lacks the required post-quantum-capable policy.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.pqc_tls.pass_when: PASS when the distribution uses a custom viewer certificate and its MinimumProtocolVersion is in CF_PQC.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.pqc_tls.fail_when: FAIL when a distribution uses the default viewer certificate or a MinimumProtocolVersion outside the evaluator’s PQC policy set.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.recommended_tls_polic.description: This CloudFront check requires a ViewerCertificate object with MinimumProtocolVersion in CF_RECOMMENDED_TLS. A missing certificate object or a version outside that set fails.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.recommended_tls_polic.pass_when: PASS when a ViewerCertificate exists and its MinimumProtocolVersion is in CF_RECOMMENDED_TLS.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.recommended_tls_polic.fail_when: FAIL when viewerCertificate is absent or its MinimumProtocolVersion is outside CF_RECOMMENDED_TLS.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_cont.description: This check fails when an S3 origin lacks OriginAccessControlId. As a result, the bucket may need direct public access to serve content.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_cont.pass_when: PASS when Every S3 origin has an OriginAccessControlId.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_cont.fail_when: FAIL when an S3 origin lacks OriginAccessControlId.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_cont.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not origins`.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_iden.description: This check fails when an s3.amazonaws.com origin lacks an OriginAccessIdentity. As a result, the bucket may be served without the legacy CloudFront identity boundary.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_iden.pass_when: PASS when Every s3.amazonaws.com origin has an OriginAccessIdentity.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_iden.fail_when: FAIL when an s3.amazonaws.com origin lacks an OriginAccessIdentity.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_access_iden.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not origins`.

aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_bucket_exis.description: This CloudFront check resolves each S3 origin bucket using the account bucket inventory and, if needed, a HeadBucket probe. It fails only when a probe reports 404; a 200, 301, or 403 response counts as existing, while an unprobed name is UNKNOWN.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_bucket_exis.pass_when: PASS when each S3 origin bucket is in the account inventory or has a HeadBucket response of 200, 301, or 403.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_bucket_exis.fail_when: FAIL when any S3 origin bucket absent from the account inventory has a HeadBucket response of 404.
aws.c2b.cloudfront.s3_origin_bucket_exis.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not names`.

aws.c2b.codeartifact.domain_policy_prohi.description: This CodeArtifact domain check inspects a present permissions policy for public Allow statements under the perimeter predicate. A matching wildcard-principal statement fails; no policy is not applicable.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.domain_policy_prohi.pass_when: PASS when a present domain policy has no wildcard-principal public Allow selected by the evaluator.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.domain_policy_prohi.fail_when: FAIL when a present CodeArtifact domain policy contains a selected wildcard-principal public Allow statement.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.domain_policy_prohi.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `container is None`.

aws.c2b.codeartifact.internal_packages_b.description: This repository check selects packages whose latest version has origin INTERNAL or UNKNOWN, including packages with no version. It fails if any selected package has originConfiguration.restrictions.upstream ALLOW; repositories with no selected package are not applicable.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.internal_packages_b.pass_when: PASS when at least one INTERNAL or UNKNOWN-origin package is selected and none allows upstream access.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.internal_packages_b.fail_when: FAIL when any selected INTERNAL or UNKNOWN-origin package has originConfiguration.restrictions.upstream ALLOW.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.internal_packages_b.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no package has INTERNAL or UNKNOWN latest-version origin.

aws.c2b.codeartifact.repository_policy_p.description: This CodeArtifact repository check inspects a present permissions policy for public Allow statements under the perimeter predicate. A matching wildcard-principal statement fails; no policy is not applicable.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.repository_policy_p.pass_when: PASS when a present repository policy has no wildcard-principal public Allow selected by the evaluator.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.repository_policy_p.fail_when: FAIL when a present CodeArtifact repository policy contains a selected wildcard-principal public Allow statement.
aws.c2b.codeartifact.repository_policy_p.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `container is None`.

aws.c2b.codebuild.buildspec_not_user_con.description: This CodeBuild check fails when source.buildspec ends with .yml or .yaml, indicating a file reference under the pinned predicate. An absent or inline buildspec passes.
aws.c2b.codebuild.buildspec_not_user_con.pass_when: PASS when the project source buildspec is absent, inline, or does not end in .yml or .yaml.
aws.c2b.codebuild.buildspec_not_user_con.fail_when: FAIL when the source buildspec string ends in .yml or .yaml.

aws.c2b.codebuild.buildspec_not_yml_file.description: This CodeBuild check fails only when the final dot-delimited suffix of source.buildspec is yml. A .yaml reference passes this narrower predicate.
aws.c2b.codebuild.buildspec_not_yml_file.pass_when: PASS when the project source buildspec is absent or its final dot-delimited suffix is not yml; .yaml passes.
aws.c2b.codebuild.buildspec_not_yml_file.fail_when: FAIL when the source buildspec string's final dot-delimited suffix is yml.

aws.c2b.codebuild.built_within_90_days.description: This CodeBuild check passes when a build is in progress or a completed build ended fewer than 90 whole days before capture. A project with no such build fails, including one whose latest completed build is exactly 90 days old.
aws.c2b.codebuild.built_within_90_days.pass_when: PASS when a build is IN_PROGRESS without an endTime, or at least one completed build ended fewer than 90 whole days before the captured clock.
aws.c2b.codebuild.built_within_90_days.fail_when: FAIL when there is no in-progress build and no completed build under 90 whole days old; exactly 90 days fails.

aws.c2b.codebuild.invoked_last_90_days.description: This check fails when a CodeBuild project has no latest build or its latest build ended more than 90 days before the captured clock. As a result, an unused build project can retain credentials and webhook access.
aws.c2b.codebuild.invoked_last_90_days.pass_when: PASS when the latest build is IN_PROGRESS without an endTime, or it ended at most 90 whole days before the captured clock.
aws.c2b.codebuild.invoked_last_90_days.fail_when: FAIL when there is no latest build or its endTime is more than 90 whole days old; an in-progress latest build passes.

aws.c2b.codebuild.no_plaintext_sensitive.description: This check fails when a CodeBuild plaintext environment variable has a name matching the sensitive-name detector. As a result, a secret value can be exposed in build configuration or logs.
aws.c2b.codebuild.no_plaintext_sensitive.pass_when: PASS when no PLAINTEXT environment variable has a name selected by the sensitive-name detector.
aws.c2b.codebuild.no_plaintext_sensitive.fail_when: FAIL when a CodeBuild plaintext environment variable has a name matching the sensitive-name detector.

aws.c2b.codebuild.project_private.description: This CodeBuild project check requires projectVisibility to be PRIVATE. PUBLIC_READ fails because build results and metadata can be publicly visible.
aws.c2b.codebuild.project_private.pass_when: PASS when the project's projectVisibility is PRIVATE.
aws.c2b.codebuild.project_private.fail_when: FAIL when projectVisibility is not PRIVATE.

aws.c2b.codebuild.report_group_export_en.description: This check fails when a CodeBuild report group exports to S3 with encryptionDisabled true. As a result, test and security report data can be stored without encryption.
aws.c2b.codebuild.report_group_export_en.pass_when: PASS when an S3 report-group export has encryptionDisabled false.
aws.c2b.codebuild.report_group_export_en.fail_when: FAIL when a CodeBuild report group exports to S3 with encryptionDisabled true.

aws.c2b.codebuild.s3_logs_encrypted_when.description: This check fails when an enabled CodeBuild S3 log destination declares encryptionDisabled true. As a result, sensitive build output can be exposed at rest.
aws.c2b.codebuild.s3_logs_encrypted_when.pass_when: PASS when an enabled S3 log destination has encryptionDisabled false.
aws.c2b.codebuild.s3_logs_encrypted_when.fail_when: FAIL when an enabled CodeBuild S3 log destination declares encryptionDisabled true.

aws.c2b.codebuild.source_repo_oauth.description: For a GITHUB or BITBUCKET CodeBuild source, this check requires at least one matching source credential and OAUTH for every selected credential. No credentials or a different auth type fails.
aws.c2b.codebuild.source_repo_oauth.pass_when: PASS when a GITHUB or BITBUCKET source has at least one credential auth type and every one is OAUTH.
aws.c2b.codebuild.source_repo_oauth.fail_when: FAIL when a GITHUB or BITBUCKET source has no credential auth type or any auth type other than OAUTH.
aws.c2b.codebuild.source_repo_oauth.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `kind not in ('GITHUB', 'BITBUCKET')`.

aws.c2b.codebuild.source_url_no_credenti.description: This check examines primary and secondary CodeBuild sources whose type is BITBUCKET. It fails only for source URLs matching its Bitbucket x-token-auth or basic-auth regex, including the required .git suffix.
aws.c2b.codebuild.source_url_no_credenti.pass_when: PASS when no BITBUCKET primary or secondary source URL matches the x-token-auth or basic-auth bitbucket.org .git URL pattern.
aws.c2b.codebuild.source_url_no_credenti.fail_when: FAIL when a BITBUCKET primary or secondary source URL matches the evaluator’s x-token-auth or basic-auth bitbucket.org .git regex.

aws.c2b.codebuild.webhook_filters_anchor.description: This CodeBuild check examines ACTOR_ACCOUNT_ID, HEAD_REF, and BASE_REF webhook filter patterns. It fails if any selected alternative lacks the required start and end anchors; projects without webhook filters pass.
aws.c2b.codebuild.webhook_filters_anchor.pass_when: PASS when Every selected webhook filter pattern is anchored as required by the evaluator.
aws.c2b.codebuild.webhook_filters_anchor.fail_when: FAIL when a selected webhook filter pattern lacks the required anchor.

aws.c2b.codedeploy.lambda_not_all_at_onc.description: This check applies to Lambda CodeDeploy groups and fails for deploymentConfigName CodeDeployDefault.LambdaAllAtOnce. Other Lambda deployment configurations pass.
aws.c2b.codedeploy.lambda_not_all_at_onc.pass_when: PASS when a Lambda deployment configuration is not CodeDeployDefault.LambdaAllAtOnce.
aws.c2b.codedeploy.lambda_not_all_at_onc.fail_when: FAIL when a Lambda deployment uses CodeDeployDefault.LambdaAllAtOnce.

aws.c2b.cognito.clients_prevent_user_exi.description: This check fails when any Cognito app client does not set PreventUserExistenceErrors to ENABLED. As a result, sign-in responses can disclose whether a username exists.
aws.c2b.cognito.clients_prevent_user_exi.pass_when: PASS when Every Cognito app client has PreventUserExistenceErrors ENABLED.
aws.c2b.cognito.clients_prevent_user_exi.fail_when: FAIL when any Cognito app client does not set PreventUserExistenceErrors to ENABLED.
aws.c2b.cognito.clients_prevent_user_exi.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not clients`.

aws.c2b.cognito.clients_token_revocation.description: This check fails when any Cognito app client has EnableTokenRevocation false or omitted. As a result, compromised refresh tokens may remain usable.
aws.c2b.cognito.clients_token_revocation.pass_when: PASS when Every Cognito app client has EnableTokenRevocation true.
aws.c2b.cognito.clients_token_revocation.fail_when: FAIL when any Cognito app client has EnableTokenRevocation false or omitted.
aws.c2b.cognito.clients_token_revocation.not_applicable_when: The check returns NOT_APPLICABLE when `not clients`.

aws.c2b.cognito.waf_web_acl_associated.description: This check fails when a Cognito user pool has no WebAcl.WebACL association. As a result, user-pool endpoints lack the intended WAF filtering.
aws.c2b.cognito.waf_web_acl_associated.pass_when: PASS when the Cognito user pool has a WebAcl.WebACL association.
aws.c2b.cognito.waf_web_acl_associated.fail_when: FAIL when a Cognito user pool has no WebAcl.WebACL association.
